quiet: The capital of Norway is Oslo, and the capital of Sweden is Stockholm.
Mercury orbits at 0.39 AU from the Sun, and Venus at 0.72 AU.
A 2015 Corolla costs about 9,800, and a 2016 Civic about 10,500.
The hex code #336699 matches rgb(51, 102, 153) in this palette.
Ajax finished with 21 wins, two more than PSV with 19.
Patent US123, filed in 2004, covers a lamp.
Kings Cross opened in 1852, fifteen years after Euston in 1837.
The cake needs 200 g of flour and 50 g of sugar.
